summary: Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor Free is available on OpenCode for a limited time; current Console model docs list Free input, output and cached-read pricing, and the inference catalog contains muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free. This is Meta's Contributor tier: free access in exchange for permission to use your prompts and completions to train future Meta models. Standard Muse Spark 1.3 remains paid. Current general setup says to add billing details and credits; a model-specific payment-information waiver has not been verified, so do not assume card-free onboarding. The existing OpenCode Zen screenshot is historical user evidence, not verification of the present Console claim flow.
claim_steps: Open https://opencode.ai/v2/docs/console/models/ and follow its Console sign-in link.
Review current Console setup and billing. General instructions say to add billing details and credits; a free-model-specific payment waiver is unverified. Do not assume onboarding is card-free.
Copy your Console API key. In the OpenCode TUI, run /connect, choose the OpenCode pay-as-you-go provider and paste the key.

Run /models and select opencode/muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free. For direct API use, the documented endpoint is https://opencode.ai/inference/openai/v1/responses with model ID muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free.

The documented no-Authorization exception is for free chat models, not a verified account-free path for this Responses model. Keep the Console funding/card requirement unresolved; no inference request was tested.
Consent applies to Meta's use of your prompts and completions to train future models. Availability is limited-time; no exact end date is stated.
